verdict.rationale: Warp's API docs describe a downloadable artifact used to "generate clients, configure API development tools, or give documentation-aware AI tools access to the Warp API definition," which fits the story of a machine-readable spec, and an llms.txt index is live. However, the quoted snippet never names the format (OpenAPI or otherwise) or its URL, and probes of common OpenAPI paths all returned 404. Those were guessed paths, not a documented location, so this lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the artifact is an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, a documented download URL that resolves, independent or hands-on verification of the spec file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Use it to generate clients, configure API development tools, or give documentation-aware AI tools access to the Warp API definition.
